name: DELTARUNE Fight Sim
summary: deltarunesim.com: 300+ DELTARUNE and UNDERTALE boss fights in a fan-made browser battle sim.
description: puskevi's free, fan-made DELTARUNE Fight Simulator as a TV app: over 300 DELTARUNE and UNDERTALE fights, boss rush, autoplay, replays and bonus games. Runs in a Vega WebView streaming from deltarunesim.com; the site is not affiliated with Toby Fox and is free (no account, no ads). Remote mapping: D-pad moves the SOUL, OK/Play-Pause = Z confirm, Back/Rewind = X cancel, Menu/Fast-forward = Tab toolbox. It is a WASM/WebGL engine, so a Fire TV Stick 4K or newer is the realistic floor; on weaker sticks it may fail to boot (terminate and relaunch once).
author: Madrinth

install.note: Prebuilt .vpkg is published on the FYAISA releases page. If no matching build exists, the host installer builds it from apps/deltarunesim with the Vega SDK.

notes: Wraps the fan-made deltarunesim.com simulator; streams from the site, so the stick needs internet. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Toby Fox; DELTARUNE and UNDERTALE are (c) Toby Fox. Buy the real games.
Requires Developer Mode on the Fire TV; not installable from the Amazon Appstore.
